en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_schedule_ongoing: The whiteboard schedule governs the basement's hours - and governs $names$.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_schedule_result_: $names$ kneels ready at the playroom door per the schedule. As the wall clock strikes the hour, the door opens - "Two minutes late. Noted: time added."
The ledger of added time is read aloud to her: two extensions for late bedtimes, three for loosened positions. He closes the notebook. "A toy must know its own debts."
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_display_ongoing: No training today. The old man is merely 'putting things in order'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_display_result_1: $names$ is bound into a fixed pose and placed on the basement's display rack, shelved with the lacquered wooden saddles. He sits nearby sanding wood, glancing up now and then to check her condition.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_display_result_2: The playroom lights dim. $names$ is bound to the rack facing the door - "When guests arrive, the exhibits stand in the most visible spot."
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_toy_ongoing: The tail plug and an apron make up today's entire 'outfit'.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_toy_result_1: $names$ carries tea and bows across the whole basement with the tail plug seated. The spilled portion of the tea will be repaid kneeling on the rack.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_toy_result_2: The old man swaps in a larger plug and pats her back like tightening a screw on furniture. "Sit straight. It doesn't drop today."
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_maintenance_resu: $names$ washes, dries and shelves each used toy by size. For any misplaced piece, the old man demonstrates its use on her all over again.
Amid the sanding, she is called over to test a new toy's grip - "Fingers, not hips. You only hold it. Whether it works well is for me to say."
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_check_ongoing: "Come here." The old man sets down his carving knife and beckons.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sm_small_check_result: He puts his work aside and runs an impromptu re-check on the spot: rubber gloves, lubricant, segment by segment. He adds a line to the record and says nothing at all.
